sources.snippet: The SO-ARM101 uses a dual-camera system matching the real hardware: Gripper Camera — Mounted on the end effector, provides close-up view for manipulation tasks. Used for precise grasping and visual servoing. External Camera — Overhead/side view of the workspace. Provides context for the AI agent about the overall scene layout.
